commentary: With Nifty pausing near the 25,800-26,000 zone after an extended run, the deterministic breadth score of 48 warrants caution under Stan Weinstein's market cycle principles. Headline benchmarks reflect selective distribution in heavyweight IT and private banks, yet underlying institutional accumulation remains vigorous, evidenced by ₹11,474 crore in net institutional buying and sector breakouts in capital goods and defence. William O'Neil's market-direction framework advises against aggressive index exposure during consolidation phases. Investors must demand strict Stage 2 alignment above rising 30-week averages, prioritize setups demonstrating authentic CANSLIM quarterly earnings acceleration, and deploy Minervini's progressive exposure rules—relying on tight pivot stop discipline rather than chasing extended leaders.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Forming the right side of a double bottom toward the 1,048.30 neckline pivot. Price is stacked cleanly above the rising 21-day EMA, 50-day SMA, and 200-day SMA, confirming Minervini Trend Template criteria. RSI at 68 reflects strong momentum without overextension.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Explosive earnings acceleration driven by caffeine/xanthine global leadership and expanding CDMO contracts. Standalone operating margins stabilized at ~22.2%. Demerger efficiencies compound with manageable debt and 11% ROCE, satisfying CANSLIM C+A criteria.
AARTIPHARM.risk: A drop below the 979.65 pivot support invalidates the double-bottom pattern; execute an immediate stop to limit capital drawdown.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Carving a double bottom with neckline entry at 427.88 on 1.82x volume expansion. Price holds constructively above its rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, displaying institutional sponsorship and orderly accumulation with RSI at 57.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: AUM expanded across NBFC and housing finance portfolios while Gross Stage 3 asset quality improved to 0.65-2.31%. However, quarterly EPS growth moderated from 40% to 32%; O'Neil discipline caps this setup at Watch despite 31% top-line growth.
ABCAPITAL.risk: Breaching 405.96 compromises base support; exit promptly per Minervini risk discipline.

ABDL.technical: Advancing off 21-EMA and 50-DMA support with a 3-up continuation pattern towards the 855.55 neckline trigger. Moving averages trend upward in Stage 2 alignment, though volume on advances remains inconsistent.
ABDL.fundamental: Quarterly volumes crossed 10 million cases led by ICONiQ White, but EBITDA margins at 12.4% remain compressed by supply-chain and raw-material costs. Sub-25% EPS growth fails O'Neil's core CANSLIM threshold, requiring patience.
ABDL.risk: A breakdown below 796.83 invalidates the EMA pullback structure, mandating strict capital protection.

ACE.technical: Textbook SEPA breakout to fresh 52-week highs, clearing a 20-session resistance on 1.92x average volume. Aligns flawlessly with Minervini's 8-point Trend Template above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA with top-tier relative strength.
ACE.fundamental: Commands 63% domestic mobile crane share. Surging capex and defence order pipelines drove Q2 PAT up 82% YoY. Negligible debt (D/E 0.06), 28.5% ROCE, 20.6% ROE, and unpledged 65.4% promoter holding reflect supreme institutional quality.
ACE.risk: Reversal below 1,215.50 negates the breakout pivot, requiring an immediate stop-out.

ACMESOLAR.technical: Coiling tightly within 1.5% of its 477.38 pivot on massive 3.01x volume accumulation. Moving averages conform to Stage 2 advancing criteria. RSI at 71 reflects powerful upside thrust without climactic exhaustion.
ACMESOLAR.fundamental: Benefiting from aggressive battery energy storage (BESS) commissioning, driving 90% revenue growth and 110% EPS expansion. Robust 86-88% operating margins offset elevated utility leverage, supported by 71.4% unpledged promoter ownership.
ACMESOLAR.risk: A close below 453.71 breaches the consolidation floor; exit immediately to preserve trading capital.

AEGISLOG.technical: Cleared 20-session resistance to mark multi-month highs above rising moving averages. However, breakout volume is moderate at 1.16x and RSI at 72 indicates near-term overextension, warning against chasing.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Dominant LPG and chemical storage player with ROCE of 13.3% and ROE of 16.5%. While top-line growth is robust, profit growth decelerated from triple digits and promoter holding dropped 4.4%, warranting restraint.
AEGISLOG.risk: A pullback beneath 1,427.86 violates the breakout shelf; enforce the stop to curb downside.
